document.abstract: The design of this spray processor, four of which are now in full operation, using impingement drying, was based on both experimental data of the last two decades and operational experience gathered during the last two years. These are used for developing 16mm and 35mm black-and-white negatives and positives of all types at 80 F. The great versatility of the units, along with accurate sensitometry and chemistry, has increased both quality and volume in the laboratory.
